policies.browser: Only event IDs present in both the API receipt and real browser draw observation count as presentation/browser.
policies.partial: A failed sibling scenario is excluded explicitly; a passing independent mode may remain valid.
policies.fingerprints: Legacy modes use their recorded producer/presentation source subset; Atlas uses every captured source.
